review: The hymn is the love of the crucified: 1:1–5 is Song 5:16 with Phil 3:8 and John 6:56, 2:1–4 is Isa 53:5 with Phil 2:8, 3:1–4 is Matt 27:33 with Isa 53:10, 4:1–4 is Gal 2:20 with Lam 1:12, and 5:1–4 is John 19:34 with Zech 13:1.
Stanza 1 is five lines and the rest four (5/4/4/4/4), the print's `10.8.10.8 – 10.10.8.7.11.11`; the payload keeps the extra line rather than merging it.

1:3 אֶמְשְׁשֶׁנּוּ, אַרְגִּישֶׁנּוּ — the Arabic أَلْمِسُهُ أُحِسُّهُ pairs touch and feeling; the Hebrew uses מָשַׁשׁ (Gen 27:21, Exod 10:21) and רָגַשׁ in its late sense, so the line keeps the physical claiming of a person and not a metaphor of nearness.

3:4 וַתִּשְׁלַם הַיְשׁוּעָה — the Arabic فَتَمَّ الْخَلَاص is 'so salvation was accomplished'; the Hebrew uses שָׁלַם, the verb of Isa 53:10 and John 19:30 read together, because the stanza is the obedience that finishes the work.
